info.title: BeautyBOX Phase 1 application API
info.description:
Design contract, not an implemented service. Server-derived money; RWF integer amounts. API prefix /api/v1. ISO UTC timestamps, opaque cursor pagination. Cookie auth requires origin/CSRF defense. All mutations use version checks where specified; idempotent intent keys claimed atomically. Staff roles are server DB records plus active MFA session. Error status mapping: validation400/422, auth401/403, private-not-found404, state/idempotency409, rate429, unavailable503. Unknown financial outcomes stay pending. Provider wire payloads are defined by official provider schemas, not this internal contract.

v1.1.0 (BeautyBOX app): the v1.0.0 handoff contract plus documented additive changes CC-01..CC-21 (docs/CONTRACT-CHANGES.md). No v1.0.0 path, request field or status code was removed.

post.summary: CC-18: finance resolves a refund flagged NEEDS_REVIEW
post.description: Only for a refund with verificationFlag NEEDS_REVIEW, after checking the payment in the provider's dashboard. AS_RECORDED clears the flag (a failed refund's amount becomes refundable again). PAID_BY_PROVIDER records a refund recorded as failed as paid out, for paidAmountRwf (default and maximum: the refund's amount), with the provider reference finance saw (required). Audited; never moves money.

post.summary: CC-20: enter the pre-launch access code
post.description: Same-origin only; attempts are rate-limited per address. A right code sets the HttpOnly SiteAccess cookie (30 days) and returns where to go next (a same-site path; anything else becomes /). A wrong code is 401 UNAUTHORIZED with a field error on code. When the wall is off it returns next without setting a cookie.

post.summary: CC-20: ask for one message when the shop opens (e-mail and/or Rwanda mobile number)
post.description: Accepted from the shop's origin or a holding host. At least one of email or phone, and consent true. 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED while the list is closed. The answer is the same whether or not the details were already on the list. Details are stored encrypted and used only for the launch message.

SiteAccess.name: bb_site_access
SiteAccess.description: CC-20: set by POST /site-access. While the pre-launch wall is on, every operation except the staff API, provider callbacks, the job runner, /site-access and /launch-list answers 401 UNAUTHORIZED (Error) without this cookie. On a holding host (the main domain before launch) only /launch-list is served. The wall is off once the shop opens.
